created_prompt: Draft a three-year business/growth plan that will support Julie in expanding her online presence and help her decide wheter to publish a cookbook via traditional or self-publishing means. Consider that she works four days a week and has limited time and budget. The strategy should be step-by-step, broken down by year and quarter, and cover topics like content, audience growth, monetization options, cookbook development goals, and a manageable workload within her constraints.
